item.title: Traffic lights at sixways as you are approaching sixways on the A40 from andoversford. The turn right traffic lights does not go green when the forward light goes green. It will change to green the next time but it means you can be sat there through 2 sequences rather than one. Some drivers ignore the red light and travel forward and wait in the junction until it's safe to turn right. The alternative is to try and get in the left hand lane and use Ewens estate as a rat run. I have reported this many many times and it's still happening., 22nd July
item.description:
Sixways junction
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 1, Greenway Lane, Battledown, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
